Compared with the left side, which is nearly empty, the right side is crowded. In the foreground, a bench has two people sitting with a guidebook. In the background, a staircase leads to a second floor, with a few people looking down. The visitors seem to follow a loop around the room, starting at the entrance on the left. Overall, the space feels calm and spacious.
quests.explanation: The learner uses all the skills of the course: priority, position, people, comparison, sequence, and overview in connected speech.
quests.hint: Lead with what stands out, then people, then a comparison, then a sequence, then a summary.
